caption: The drawing depicts a single silver or metallic ladle placed diagonally across the page, with the bowl of the ladle at the bottom left and the handle extending towards the upper right. The ladle features a deep, oval-shaped bowl and a long, narrow handle with a slight curve. The handle is decorated at the end with an ornate, symmetrical design incorporating leaf-like patterns and scrollwork, topped by an oval area that appears to have a faint inscription. The background is a plain, aged beige or light brown, with reddish-brown stains and discolorations scattered around the edges and across the surface. The artist's signature, "ROSA G. BUSEY," is written in the bottom right corner. The image is rendered in graphite or pencil, using shades of gray to create the detailed appearance of the ladle and its decorative handle.
title: Ladle
